backend.description: Serving backend the measurement ran against.

backend_model.description: Backend-local model tag that was measured, e.g. 'qwen3:8b' (Ollama) or 'mlx-community/Qwen3-8B-4bit' (MLX). Renamed from v1 'ollama_model'.

context_length.description: Context window (tokens) the model was configured with for the run.

run.description: Optional per-run detail. Unknown fields are allowed here.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first generated token in milliseconds, measured on a streaming request.

watts_avg.description: Optional. Average package power in watts during decode (macOS: powermetrics, needs sudo). Omit when unavailable.

description: Schema v2 for benchmark.json produced by `dasha-compute benchmark`. Spec: docs/BENCHMARK-HARNESS-SPEC.md. Files without schema_version are v1 (legacy, decode-only) and do not validate.

chip.description: Human chip identifier, e.g. 'Apple M4', 'Apple M1 Pro'. On macOS: sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string.

python.description: Python version running the provider agent, e.g. '3.11.9'.

harness.description: Free-form run metadata (prompt, token budget, repeats). Unknown fields are allowed here.

measured_at.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the run finished. Kept as ms epoch for v1 continuity.

results.description: One entry per measured model. Order is not significant.

schema_version.description: Schema generation. Must be 2. Absent means v1 (legacy).

title: Dasha Compute provider benchmark report
